cases.setup: An orange marble, a purple disk, and one opaque metal tin sit on the table.
cases.operation: A hand slowly places the orange marble into the tin and closes the lid. The purple disk stays on the table the whole time.
cases.expected_reveal: the tin contains the orange marble; the purple disk is still outside

cases.setup: A yellow cube, a green marble, and one opaque white lidded cup sit on the table.
cases.operation: A hand slowly places the yellow cube into the cup and closes the lid. The green marble stays on the table the whole time.
cases.expected_reveal: the cup contains the yellow cube; the green marble is still outside
